svg.title: What one AGV assignment adds to the DAG
svg.desc: Assigning AGV A to TrayMove e4 adds AgvMove(to tray), lift, sets agv_id on the TrayMove, and adds lower, with four kinds of dependency edges.
svg.metadata: ["Before: TrayMove e4 (T15: P15 -> P19) is a root of event_dag_copy with no AGV yet. BottleneckAssignment matched it to AGV A.", "MoveAgvToTrayPose() adds an AgvMove that drives A from W26 to the tray pose P15 (it is skipped when the AGV is already there).", "AppendAgvLiftEvent(raised) adds an AgvMove that lifts T15 onto A, after the drive.", "SetAgvId(A) fills in the TrayMove itself: e4 now carries T15 to P19 on AGV A, after the lift.", "AppendAgvLiftEvent(lowered) adds the lower at P19, so A is free again after e4.", "Incoming edge 1: A's previous event (last_agv_event[A]) must finish before A drives off: one chain of events per AGV.", "Incoming edge 2: if a tray stands on A's navigation path, that tray's first move (ctx->first_tray_event) must clear it first.", "Incoming edge 3: AddNodeArrivalDeps() makes A's arrival at P15 wait until the previous AGV on that node has left.", "Incoming edge 4: if agv_event_dag says another matched AGV (parent B) must go first, its last_move_to_tray_event[B] precedes A's drive.", "Finally the assignment's event_cost (travel + lift_up + carry + lift_down) is propagated to the children and added to agv_occupied_durations[A]."]

g.text: Matching only picks pairs; the loop that follows turns each pair into real events and wires them into the DAG so motion planning can replay them safely.
